summary: User rode with Corin through morning fog. He named the unlit markers.
Lock delayed an hour. Corin complained about the winch. User mostly watched the water.
User brought bad coffee. Corin drank it anyway.
User was quiet on the river. Corin did not pry. He talked about a stuck gate.
Hard rain. Corin kept the boat in. User left early.
User asked how the river was running. Corin said high and brown. That was the whole visit.
